title: Dynamic Data Masking
summary: Obscure sensitive values for unprivileged users without changing stored data.

items: Explain that DDM is presentation-layer, not encryption.

blocks.body: DDM hides data at query time for non-privileged users while the underlying data is unchanged.

terms.definition: A feature that masks column values in query results for users without UNMASK permission.

blocks.body: Add masks with `MASKED WITH (FUNCTION = 'default()' | 'partial()' | 'email()' | 'random()')`. Users with **UNMASK** see real values. DDM is **not** a security boundary against determined users — combine with RLS and least privilege.

items.fix: DDM only masks display; data is stored in clear and can be inferred via crafted queries without proper permissions.

tips: DDM is presentation-only; pair it with real access controls.

blocks.body: Use DDM to reduce accidental exposure, but never as your only control — it's cosmetic, not cryptographic.
